proposals.before: The officials requested that Henan be assigned to Jizhou and Hedong to Bingzhou.
proposals.after: The officials requested that Henei be assigned to Jizhou and Hedong to Bingzhou.
proposals.reason: 河內 is Henei, not Henan; the idiomatic rendering invents the wrong place name.

proposals.before: Officials requested Henan belong to Jizhou, Hedong belong to Bingzhou.
proposals.after: Officials requested Henei belong to Jizhou, Hedong belong to Bingzhou.
proposals.reason: Literal also mistranslates 河內 as Henan instead of Henei.

proposals.before: Moved Sefu rich people to Yunling, granted money, households one hundred thousand.
proposals.after: Moved Three Adjuncts rich people to Yunling, granted money, households one hundred thousand.
proposals.reason: 三輔 is the Three Adjuncts; 'Sefu' is a corrupted mistranslation.

proposals.before: Initially, Shangguan Jie and his son An contended for power with Grand General Huo Guang and wished to harm him. They falsely had someone submit a memorial to King Dan of Yan accusing Guang of crimes.
proposals.after: Initially, Shangguan Jie and his son An contended for power with Grand General Huo Guang and wished to harm him. They falsely had someone submit a memorial in the name of King Dan of Yan accusing Guang of crimes.
proposals.reason: 為燕王旦上書 means a memorial purporting to be from King Dan, not a memorial addressed to him.

proposals.before: Later, when there were those who slandered Guang, the emperor would always angrily say: 'The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, whom the late emperor entrusted to him. Anyone who dares to slander or defame him shall be punished.'
proposals.after: Later, when there were those who slandered Guang, the emperor would always angrily say: 'The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, whom the late emperor entrusted. Anyone who dares to slander or defame him shall be punished.'
proposals.reason: 先帝所屬 means entrusted by the late emperor; 'entrusted to him' reverses/adds a wrong argument.

proposals.before: Edict said: I pity common people not satisfied, previous year reduced tribute three hundred ten thousand shi.
proposals.after: Edict said: I pity common people not satisfied, previous year reduced tribute three million shi.
proposals.reason: 三百萬 is three million, not 'three hundred ten thousand'.

proposals.before: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezhi, holding an imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang.'
proposals.after: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding an imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang.'
proposals.reason: 傅介子 is Fu Jiezi, not Fu Jiezhi.

proposals.before: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezhi, holding imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang."
proposals.after: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang."
proposals.reason: Same name error in the literal field: 介子 is Jiezi.

proposals.before: In the twelfth month, on a Gengxu day, Chancellor Yin passed away.
proposals.after: In the twelfth month, on a Gengxu day, Chancellor Xin passed away.

decisions.reason: Source 河內 is the Henei commandery; Henan would be 河南, so the idiomatic place name must be corrected to Henei.
Source 河內 is Henei; the literal's Henan does not match the Chinese place name.

decisions.after: Later, when anyone slandered Guang, the emperor would always say angrily, 'The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, entrusted with his charge by the late emperor. Anyone who dares slander him will be punished.'
decisions.reason: 先帝所屬 means that the late emperor entrusted Guang with his charge; this revision removes the wrong argument while completing the English construction naturally.
